commands.label: Parse the exact Eagle design with the published CAD converter
Call the published schematic vector renderer directly, including geometry-only designs

export_schematic.py.content_utf8:
from pathlib import Path
import json
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
from eagle_to_svg import EagleToSvg

design = json.loads(Path("design.json").read_bytes())
EagleToSvg(design).export_schematic("greeting.svg")

toolchain: eagle-viewer 1.0.0 standalone EAGLE CAD parser and vector renderer
reproduction_command: eagle-viewer --sch hello.sch --json-only --no-open > design.json && python3 export_schematic.py <viewer source>
semantic_scope: The compatible Eagle viewer parsed the untouched schematic and its native vector renderer exported the Info-layer text geometry as SVG. The rendered SVG text contains the exact greeting.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
